title: API Proposal: automatically add classes for levels of RefinementList
body:
Following #162, we should provide a way to easily target a level of RefinementList (say, when using hierarchicalFacet) as a class. So something like this: ``` html
Fruits
oranges
bananas
``` cc @maxiloc would that fit?

comments.body: :+1: yes works for me, maybe I would only put "lvl0" but I am ok with what you proposed
